name: aiforbusiness-chat-assistant
description: Reads your WhatsApp Web open in Chrome and helps you draft replies, saved as drafts. It never sends messages, never marks as read, and never connects to outside servers. Needs the AI for Business Chat Assistant Chrome extension. Unofficial: not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.
long_description:
Ask Claude things like "who messaged me recently", "who haven't I replied to" or "what did this group talk about".

- Never sends: there is no send, reply, forward, delete or mark-as-read feature
- AI drafts: Claude writes a reply and saves it as a draft; a preview appears above the WhatsApp message box and you press send yourself
- Local only: talks to the Chrome extension over 127.0.0.1 with a pairing code; no outside servers, no analytics
- Unofficial: not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta; reads WhatsApp Web internals, which may break when WhatsApp updates; try with a work number first

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read-only: is WhatsApp Web open, is the extension connected; gives a pairing code if not paired

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: Read-only: list chats (filter by unread / groups / keyword)

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Read-only: read the latest N messages of a chat (up to 100)

tools.name: get_media
tools.description: See a photo or file in a message (read-only, only what is already on this computer)

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Download the photo, video, voice message or file in one message to your Downloads folder (never sends, never marks as read)

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Read-only: search stored messages for a keyword

tools.name: list_awaiting_reply
tools.description: Read-only: chats where they spoke last and you haven't replied

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Save a reply draft to the extension's draft list (never sent)

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: Read-only: AI drafts and what you actually sent (for comparison)
